paragraphs.text: And in the thirty-fifth jubilee, in the third week, in the first year [1681 A.M.] thereof, Reu took to himself a wife, and her name was 'Ôrâ, the daughter of 'Ûr, the son of Kesed, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Sêrôh, in the seventh year of this week in this jubilee. [1687 A.M.] And the sons of Noah began to war on each other, to take captive and to slay each other, and to shed the blood of men on the earth, and to eat blood, and to build strong cities, and walls, and towers, and individuals (began) to exalt themselves above the nation, and to found the beginnings of kingdoms, and to go to war people against people, and nation against nation, and city against city, and all (began) to do evil, and to acquire arms, and to teach their sons war, and they began to capture cities, and to sell male and female slaves.
paragraphs.original: ወበ፴ ወ፭ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ነሥእዎ፡ ለሬዑ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ኦራ፡ ወለተ፡ ኦራ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሰሩግ፡ በሰቡዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡
paragraphs.translit: waba30 wa5 ʾiyobēlwu śāləs sabuʿ baqadāmāwi ʿāmat lazəntu ʾiyobēlwu naśəʾwo larēʿu bəʾsita səmā ʾorā walata ʾorā lotu bəʾsita wawaladat lotu walda wasamayo səmo sarug basabuʿ ʿāmat lazəntu ʾiyobēlwu

paragraphs.text: And 'Ûr, the son of Kesed, built the city of 'Ara of the Chaldees, and called its name after his own name and the name of his father. And they made for themselves molten images, and they worshipped each the idol, the molten image which they had made for themselves, and they began to make graven images and unclean simulacra, and malignant assisted and seduced (them) into committing transgression and uncleanness.
paragraphs.original: ወአኀዙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ ይትባአሱ፡ አሐዱ፡ ለመጻዐ፡ ካልኡ፡ ወይትገበሩ፡ ቀትለ፡ ወይትፋጻኡ፡ ደመ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወይውግዙ፡ ምድረ፡ ወይትገበሩ፡ ሐጻነ፡ ወወለዱ፡ ኪነ፡ ለቀትል፡ ወቀምሮ፡ ለመስከባን፡
paragraphs.translit: waʾaḫazu daqiqa noḫ yətbāʾasu ʾaḥadu lamaṣāʿa kālʾu wayətgabaru qatla wayətfāṣāʾu dama lāʿla mədər waywəgzu mədra wayətgabaru ḥaṣāna wawaladu kina laqatəl waqamro lamaskabān

paragraphs.text: prince Mastêmâ exerted himself to do all this, and he sent forth other spirits, those which were put under his hand, to do all manner of wrong and sin, and all manner of transgression, to corrupt and and to shed blood upon the earth.
paragraphs.original: ወአኀዙ፡ ይትገበሩ፡ ጣዖታት፡ ወሰገዱ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ በበ፡ ሥርዐቱ፡ ዘያረኵስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወአስተአተተ፡ መስተማ፡ ይግበር፡ ኪያሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: waʾaḫazu yətgabaru ṭāʿotāt wasagadu kiyāhomu kʷəlu sabəʾ baba śərʿatu zayārakʷəs lāʿla mədər waʾastaʾatata mastamā yəgbar kiyāhomu

paragraphs.text: For this reason he called the name of Sêrôh, Serug, turned to do all manner of sin and transgression. And he grew up, and dwelt in Ur of the Chaldees, near to the father of his wife's mother, and he worshipped idols, and he took to himself a wife in the thirty-sixth jubilee, in the fifth week, in the first year thereof, [1744 A.M.] and her name was Melka, the daughter of Kaber, the daughter of his father's brother.
paragraphs.original: ወመስተማ፡ መልአከ፡ ጻዕር፡ አስተሐሰሰ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ለማስኖ፡ ወለመውዓ፡ ወለክዕወ፡ ደም፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wamastamā malʾaka ṣāʿər ʾastaḥasasa kiyāhomu lamawāʿəl lamāsno walamawʿā walakəʿwa dam lāʿla mədər

paragraphs.text: And she bare him Nahor, in the first year of this week, and he grew and dwelt in Ur of the Chaldees, and his father taught him the researches of the Chaldees to divine and augur, according to the signs of heaven.
paragraphs.original: ወአስተአተቶሙ፡ መስተማ፡ ለመናፍስት፡ ዘይትገበሩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግፍዐ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ለሙስና፡ ወለማስኖ፡ ወለክዕወ፡ ደም፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: waʾastaʾatatomu mastamā lamanāfsət zayətgabaru kʷəlo gəfʿa wakʷlo ḫaṭiʾata wakʷlo ʿamaḍā lamusnā walamāsno walakəʿwa dam lāʿla mədər

paragraphs.text: thirty-seventh jubilee in the sixth week, in the first year thereof, [1800 A.M.] he took to himself a wife, and her name was 'Ijaska, the daughter of Nestag of the Chaldees. And she bare him Terah in the seventh year of this week. [1806 A.M.] And the prince Mastêmâ sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land, in order to destroy the land, and rob the children of men of their labours. Before they in the seed, the ravens picked (it) from the surface of the ground.
paragraphs.original: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተሰምየ፡ ስሙ፡ ለሰሩግ፡ ሰሩግ፡ እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኮኑ፡ ይትገሐሡ፡ ኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡
paragraphs.translit: baʾənta zəntu tasamya səmu lasarug sarug ʾəsma kʷəlu sabəʾ konu yətgaḥaśu ḫaba kʷəlu ḫaṭiʾat

paragraphs.text: And for this reason he called his name Terah because the ravens and the birds reduced them to destitution and And the years began to be barren, owing to the birds, and they devoured all the fruit of the trees from the trees: it was only with great effort that they could save a little of all the earth in their days.
paragraphs.original: ወልሕቀ፡ ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ኦራ፡ ይእቲ፡ ምድረ፡ ካስድ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ለእምሕያ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወሰገደ፡ ጣዖታተ፡ ወነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ሚልካ፡ ወለተ፡ ካበር፡ ወለተ፡ እኁሁ፡ ለአቡሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: waləḥqa waḫadara mədra ʾorā yəʾti mədra kāsəd qəruba laʾabuhu laʾməḥyā ʾabuhu wasagada ṭāʿotāta wanaśʾa lotu bəʾsita səmā milkā walata kābar walata ʾəḫuhu laʾabuhu

paragraphs.text: And in this thirty-ninth jubilee, in the second week in the first year, [1870 A.M.] Terah took to himself a wife, and her name was 'Edna, the daughter of 'Abram, the daughter of his father's sister. And in the seventh year of this week [1876 A.M.] she bare him a son, and he called his name Abram, by the name of the father of his mother; for he had died before his daughter had conceived a son.
paragraphs.original: ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ናኮር፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡
paragraphs.translit: wawaladat lotu nākor baqadāmāwi ʿāmat lazəntu sabuʿ

paragraphs.text: And the child began to understand the errors of the earth that all went astray after graven images and after uncleanness, and his father taught him writing, and he was two weeks of years old, [1890 A.M.] and he separated himself from his father, that he might not worship idols with him.
paragraphs.original: ወልሕቀ፡ ናኮር፡ ወመሐሮ፡ አቡሁ፡ ኪነ፡ ለመጠን፡ ኪደ፡ ከለዳዊያን፡ ለድልዋን፡ ለቀሥሞ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወከመ፡ ይትፅዐኑ፡ ቦቶሙ፡ ለኪደ፡ ሰማይ፡
paragraphs.translit: waləḥqa nākor wamaḥaro ʾabuhu kina lamaṭan kida kaladāwiyān ladəlwān laqaśmo gizē wakama yətəḍʿanu botomu lakida samāy

paragraphs.text: began to pray to the Creator of all things that He might save him from the errors of the children of his portion should not fall into error after uncleanness and vileness. And the seed time came for the sowing of seed upon the land, and they all went forth together to protect their seed ravens, and Abram went forth with those that went, and the child was a lad of fourteen And a cloud of ravens came to devour the seed, and Abram ran to meet them before they settled on the ground, and cried to them before they settled on the ground to devour the seed, and not: return to the place whence ye came,' and they proceeded to turn back.
paragraphs.original: ወበ፴ ወ፯ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ናኮር፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ አያስ፡ ወለተ፡ ናስስ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ታራ፡ በሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡
paragraphs.translit: waba30 wa7 ʾiyobēlwu qadāmāwi sabuʿ baqadāmāwi ʿāmat lazəntu sabuʿ naśʾa lotu nākor bəʾsita səmā ʾayās walata nāsəs bəʾsita wawaladat lotu walda wasamayo səmo tārā baśāləs sabuʿ

paragraphs.text: caused the clouds of ravens to turn back that day seventy times, and of all the ravens throughout where Abram was there settled there not so much as one. And all who were with him throughout all the land saw him cry out, and all the ravens turn back, and his name became great land of the Chaldees.
paragraphs.original: ወአስተአተተ፡ መስተማ፡ ቅንስናተ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ለበሊዐ፡ ዘርእ፡ ዘይዘርእ፡ ሰብእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ከመ፡ ያስተአትትዎ፡ ለዘርእ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ወይትግፋዕዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ ዘርኦሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: waʾastaʾatata mastamā qənəsnāta ʾaʿwāf labaliʿa zarəʾ zayzarəʾ sabəʾ lāʿla mədər kama yāstaʾatətwo lazarəʾ ʾəmna mədər waytəgfāʿwomu ladaqiqa sabəʾ ʾəmna zarʾomu

paragraphs.text: And there came to him this year all those that wished to sow, and he went with them until the time of sowing ceased: and they sowed their land, and that year enough grain home and eat and were satisfied.
paragraphs.original: ወይዘርኡ፡ ዘርአ፡ በምድር፡ ወይትራባእ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወይትባልዕዎ፡ እምነ፡ መንበረ፡ መንበራቲሆሙ፡ ለመረረ፡ ፍሬ፡ መጠን፡ ምድሮሙ፡ ለመውዓ፡ ለነጊር፡ ለሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ ፍሬሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wayzarʾu zarʾa bamdər wayətrābāʾ ʾaʿwāf wayətbāləʿwo ʾəmna manbara manbarātihomu lamarara fərē maṭan mədromu lamawʿā lanagir lasabəʾ ʾəmna fərēhomu

paragraphs.text: And in the first year of the fifth week [1891 A.M.] Abram taught those who made implements for oxen, the artificers in wood, and they made a vessel above the ground, facing the frame of the plough, in order to put the seed thereon, and the seed fell down therefrom upon the share of the plough, and was hidden in the earth, and they no longer feared the And after this manner they made (vessels) above the ground on all the frames of the ploughs, and they sowed and tilled all the land, according as Abram commanded them, and they no longer feared the birds.
paragraphs.original: ወወረሐ፡ ሐራ፡ መሥራቅ፡ ወወረዱ፡ መንገለ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወአፍርሁ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለስሕተተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወረከቡ፡ መከራ፡ ብዙኀ
paragraphs.translit: wawaraḥa ḥarā maśrāq wawaradu mangala ḍaḥay waʾafərhu kiyāhomu lasəḥtata lāʿla mədər warakabu makarā bəzuḫa

paragraphs.text: The Apocrypha and Pseudepigrapha of the Old Testament by R.H. Charles, Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1913 Scanned and Edited by Joshua Williams, Northwest Nazarene College
paragraphs.original: ወበ፴ ወ፱ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ሰዱስ፡ ዓመት፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ታራ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ኤድና፡ ወለተ፡ አብራም፡ ወለተ፡ እኅቱ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሳድስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ አብራም፡ በስመ፡ አቡሁ፡ ለእሙ፡ እስመ፡ ሞተ፡ ቅድመ፡ ይትፀነሰ፡ ወልዱ፡ ለታራ፡ ወአኀዘ፡ ሕፃን፡ ያእምር፡ ኀጢአተ፡ ጣዖታት፡ ለመጠን፡ ኪደ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኅዙብ፡ ወይትገሐሥ፡ መንፈሰ፡ እምነ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወመንፈሰ፡ ሥሣይ፡ ለረከቦ፡ ምሐራ፡ እምነ፡ አባዊሁ፡ ወአኀዘ፡ ይጼሊ፡ ኀበ፡ ፈጣሪ፡ ኵሉ፡ ከመ፡ ያድኅኖ፡ እምነ፡ ስሕተተ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ መክፈልቱ፡ ለመውዓ፡ ድኅረ፡ ስሕተት፡ ለማስኖ፡ ወዘመነ፡ ዘርእ፡ ቦአ፡ ለዘሪዓ፡ ዘርእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወወፅኡ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ለመጠን፡ ይትዓቀብዎ፡ ለዘርእ፡ እምነ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወአብራም፡ ወልድ፡ ዘ፲ ወ፬ ዓመት፡ ወፅአ፡ ምስለ፡ እለ፡ ዘርኡ፡ ወይትራባእ፡ ጊፋ፡ ዘ፷ ሕፃንየ፡ አኀዘ፡ ይኬሐል፡ ለነፋጾ፡ ቅንስናተ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ቅድመ፡ ይውህጡ፡ ዘርአ፡ ወይትራባእ፡ ቅንስናተ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ መንገሌሁ፡ ወይነፍጹ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ምዕር፡ ላዕለ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘወድቀ፡ ቦቱ፡ ለመጠን፡ ኪያሁ፡ ዘፍሬ፡ መንበር፡ ወትትሥራዕ፡ ስሙ፡ ለመጠን፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ በዘ፡ መጠን፡ ጥቀ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ኮኑ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ሕያው፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወቱ፡ ወልሕቀ፡ በውስተ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዓመት፡ ወወፅአ፡ መንገለ፡ ዘረዐ፡ ዘርእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወዐቀቦ፡ ለዘርእ፡ እምነ፡ መንቅዕተ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወገብረ፡ ኪነ፡ ለዕፀዊሆሙ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይከውን፡ ቤቶ፡ ለዘርእ፡ ይውስኩ፡ ቦቶሙ፡ ለቆስ፡ ምድረ፡ ዘይከሥቱ፡ ቆስ፡ ፍርጹጻተ፡ ለርእስ፡ ዘርእ፡ ወይውፅኡ፡ ዘርአ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትራባእ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘርእ፡ ሕቡእ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ወገብሩ፡ ከመዝ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ወጻድቅ፡ ኮኑ፡ በዓመቱ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ለዘ፡ ዘርእ፡ ብዙኀ፡ በውስቴታ፡ ለበሊዕ፡ ወአልቦ፡ መከራ፡ ካልአ፡ ለመጠን፡ ዘገብረ፡ አብራም፡
